title: 12V 100Ah LiFePO4 Battery Group 31 Bluetooth 15000+ Deep Cycles
sellingPoints: 【Extended Lifespan & Unmatched Value】Featuring premium LiFePO4 cells, it delivers 4000+ cycles at 100% depth of discharge (up to 15000+ at 60% DOD) —giving you 8-10 times the longevity​ of traditional lead-acid batteries. This translates to reliable power for your RV, solar setup, or frequent use for over 10 years, significantly lowering your long-term cost and eliminating frequent replacements.

【Lightweight & Easy to Handle】Weighing only 21 lbs per battery—about one-third the weight of a comparable lead-acid battery. You can transport and install it with ease, even by yourself. It won’t weigh down your RV, boat, or camping gear, making your adventures and setups simpler and safer.

【Smart BMS & Rugged Safety】A built-in Smart BMS protects your battery and devices​ from overcharge, over-discharge, over-current, and short circuits. With an IP65 waterproof/dustproof rating and a wide operating temperature range (-4°F to 140°F), you can trust it in harsh outdoor environments, whatever the weather.

【Scalable & Flexible Power】Designed for easy expansion, it supports up to 4 in series and 4 in parallel. You can start small and scale up​ to 51.2V 400Ah seamlessly—building a custom power bank perfectly tailored to your growing energy needs for your off-grid home, large RV, or power station.

【Versatile Application & Reliable Support】It’s your ideal power partner for RVs, boats, solar storage, off-grid living, and portable power. No matter how you use it, dedicated 7x12 hour customer support is here to ensure your setup is worry-free and your questions are answered promptly.
